title: Exact positive-lambda ST8/Q3LOCK common real-time automorphism five-condition audit
question: Does the exact fixed-lattice positive-lambda ST8/Q3LOCK Hamiltonian define one source-, phase- and beta-independent infinite-volume real-time automorphism group on the already declared spatial quasi-local algebra?

exact_model.parameter_scope: hbar>0, chi>0, c>0, g>0, lambda>0, r real; the EXP-000782 phase regime additionally has r<0 and its displayed sufficient inequalities
exact_model.lattice_scope: fixed spacing, fixed block origin, unweighted ST8 on even open rectangles or even periodic cubes in Z3
exact_model.source_scope: The target dynamics is the zero-source net H_L(0). Compact sources may be used only for uniform estimates or state selection and may not label the limiting action.
exact_model.beta_scope: Beta labels equilibrium states only and may not enter the definition of the limiting C-star action.
exact_model.phase_scope: The plus and minus Euclidean phases must be states or quotient representations of the same action; a phase-labelled direct sum is excluded.

exact_model.volume_limit: all finite shapes exhausting Z3, with exhaustion independence for both time orientations
exact_model.continuum_limit: not in scope; lattice spacing remains fixed

decision_rule.MAINLINE_ADVANCE: All five conditions are proved for the exact model and independently verified.
decision_rule.NEGATIVE_RESULT: An exact contradiction or carrier-independent no-go for the stated exact-Q3 target is proved.
decision_rule.HOLD_FOR_EVIDENCE: At least one required condition remains unproved and no exact target-level contradiction is proved.

reason_not_negative: Every registered no-go used here rejects a named carrier, topology, implication, factorization, or theorem import. The authorities explicitly retain strong, local-strict, smeared, energy-weighted, resolvent-smoothed, or other common-alpha routes. No contradiction to existence of every admissible exact-Q3 common dynamics is proved.
assumptions: The hash-pinned strategy manifests and append-only exploration records are the current Q3LOCK authorities.
The target is fixed lattice spacing and zero source; no continuum or physical interpretation is part of this audit.
Point-norm C0 is required for the final C-star automorphism group even when local-strict or state-weighted topologies are used as proof intermediates.
The phasewise EXP-000790 OS systems remain valid only at their registered conditional equilibrium scope.
missing_assumptions: One exact-Q3 common invariant domain or core embedded densely in the chosen spatial quasi-local C-star carrier.
A source-, cutoff-, volume-, shape-, phase-, beta- and history-uniform two-orientation locality or energy estimate for the simultaneous quartic onsite and bilinear spatial terms.
